feature: Collection quick filters, PR 2: the chip strip
note: One route, three states, four widths. At 1180 and 1300 the strip rides the shared chassis chip row after a `Quick:` lead; at 390 and 820 (the compact form, which never used the chassis) it is its own row under Filters / Sort. `?quick=gc` is a fact chip pressed, `?avail=free` is In no deck pressed, which is the Availability menu's Free: the two controls are one state. The other chassis routes (decks, games, precons, the commanders rack, sets) are pinned unchanged by filter-chassis.test.tsx rather than photographed: the strip is an opt-in prop they never pass.
